主要内容: On February 17, 2015, the Compensation Committee of the Board of Directors of SanDisk Corporation approved several actions affecting officer compensation, including bonuses for fiscal year 2014, base salaries, and target bonus percentages for fiscal year 2015 for the Named Executive Officers. The approved bonus amounts for fiscal year 2014 for the Named Executive Officers are as follows: Sanjay Mehrotra (President and Chief Executive Officer) received $1,875,000, Judy Bruner (Executive Vice President, Administration and Chief Financial Officer) received $775,500, Sumit Sadana (Executive Vice President and Chief Strategy Officer) received $581,000, and Dr. Siva Sivaram (Executive Vice President, Memory Technology) received $431,000. The approved base salaries, effective as of February 23, 2015, are $1,050,000 for Sanjay Mehrotra, $651,000 for Judy Bruner, $542,000 for Sumit Sadana, and $490,000 for Dr. Siva Sivaram. The approved target bonus percentages for fiscal year 2015 are 150% for Sanjay Mehrotra, 100% for Judy Bruner, 90% for Sumit Sadana, and 75% for Dr. Siva Sivaram.
